## Load and build dataframe
```{r}
# data of 3 participants which took part in three sessions (TUS, SHAM and active control stimulation)
data <- read_excel("Data2Regress250520_Behaviour.xlsx") #no eeg THIS DATA ALREADY EXCLUDE MISSING TRIALS = 113
# Define categories as factor variable
Stimulation <- factor(data$Stimulation, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("aMCC", "SHAM", "PCC", "NoSTIM"))
Congruence <- factor(data$Congruence, levels = c(-1,1), labels = c("incongruent", "congruent"))
#Subject <- factor(data$Subject, levels = c(1:12) )#,labels = c("S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8", "S9", "S11","S13","S15","S17", "S18"))
Subject <- data$Subject
RT <- data$RT #reaction time
Answer <- data$Error # Participants' answer (0 = incorrect; 1 = correct)
#Error <- data$Error # answer of previous trial (nevermind the name "error"), it can be used to observe behaviour after error
Trnr <- data$Trnr # trial number (600 trials each session, nans were excluded)
BlockTrnr <- data$BlockTrnr # block number (10 blocks each session)
Feedback <- data$Feedback

df <- data.frame(Subject,Stimulation, Trnr, BlockTrnr, Congruence, RT, Answer)
df$Stimulation <- relevel(df$Stimulation,"SHAM")
df$Congruence <- relevel(df$Congruence,"congruent")
df$Correct <- ifelse(df$Answer == 1, "Correct", "Error")
# Calculate mean and standard deviation of RT
mean_RT <- mean(df$RT, na.rm = TRUE)

sd_RT <- sd(df$RT, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter out trials with RT outside ±3 standard deviations
df <- df %>%
 filter(RT >= 0.08 & RT <= 0.9)
  #filter(RT >= (mean_RT - 3 * sd_RT) & RT <= (mean_RT + 3 * sd_RT))

# Add a log-transformed reaction time column
df$log_RT <- log(df$RT)


df$log_RT <- log(df$RT)
#print(df)
#summary(df)

df<- df %>%
  filter(Stimulation != "NoSTIM")
df$BlockTrnr_z <- scale(df$BlockTrnr, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
df$Trnr_z      <- scale(df$Trnr, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

summary(df)
```

```{r} 
# Ensure the data is sorted by Subject and Trial number (Trnr) to maintain the correct order
df <- df %>%
  arrange(Subject, BlockTrnr,Trnr)

# Create a new variable for the accuracy of the previous trial
df <- df %>%
  group_by(Subject,BlockTrnr) %>%  # Group by subject to ensure it resets for each subject
  mutate(Error_Tm1 = lag(Answer, n = 1)) %>%  # Use lag to get the previous trial's accuracy
  mutate(Error_Tm1 = ifelse(Trnr == min(Trnr), NA, Error_Tm1))  # Set first trial of each block to NA


# Check the first few rows to confirm the new variable
head(df)

```


```{r}

df_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(BlockTrnr, Stimulation, Congruence) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_acc = mean(Answer, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_acc  = sd(Answer, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
 mutate(BlockTrnr = factor(as.numeric(BlockTrnr), levels = 1:12))
df_summary$Stimulation <- relevel(df_summary$Stimulation,"aMCC")
ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = BlockTrnr, y = mean_acc,
                       color = Stimulation, fill = Stimulation)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Congruence) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Stimulation), size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_acc - sem_acc,
                  ymax = mean_acc + sem_acc,
                  group = Stimulation),
              alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  labs(
    x = "Block",
    y = "Mean ACC (± SEM)",
    title = "Acc Evolution Across Blocks (Mean ± SEM)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

## Task Stage Analysis (Early, Middle, Late)

```{r}
# Create task stage variable based on block number
df_stages <- df %>%
  mutate(
    TaskStage = case_when(
      BlockTrnr >= 1 & BlockTrnr <= 4 ~ "Early",
      BlockTrnr >= 5 & BlockTrnr <= 8 ~ "Middle",
      BlockTrnr >= 9 & BlockTrnr <= 12 ~ "Late",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    TaskStage = factor(TaskStage, levels = c("Early", "Middle", "Late"))
  )

# Aggregate data by task stage and stimulation condition for ACCURACY
accuracy_by_stage <- df_stages %>%
  group_by(Subject, TaskStage, Stimulation, Congruence) %>%
  summarise(
    Accuracy = mean(Answer, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

accuracy_by_stage$Stimulation <- relevel(accuracy_by_stage$Stimulation, "aMCC")
accuracy_by_stage$Congruence <- relevel(accuracy_by_stage$Congruence, "congruent")

# Plot accuracy by task stage and stimulation condition
p_acc_stage <- ggplot(accuracy_by_stage, aes(x = TaskStage, y = 1-Accuracy, fill = Stimulation)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "summary",
    fun = mean,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    alpha = 0.7,
    color = "black",
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  # geom_point(
  #   aes(group = Stimulation),
  #   position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
  #   shape = 21,
  #   size = 2,
  #   stroke = 0.3,
  #   alpha = 0.5
  # ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Stimulation) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC" = "#CC6677",
    "SHAM" = "#E69F00",
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy Across Task Stages by Stimulation Condition",
    x = "Task Stage",
    y = "Accuracy (Proportion Correct)",
    fill = "Stimulation"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(p_acc_stage)
```

```{r}
    y = "Reaction Time (seconds)",
    fill = "Stimulation"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(p_rt_stage)
```

```{r}
# Bayesian multilevel model for accuracy by task stage, stimulation, and congruence
library(brms)

# Prepare data for brms - ensure proper factor coding
accuracy_by_stage_model <- accuracy_by_stage %>%
  mutate(
    TaskStage   = factor(TaskStage,   levels = c("Early", "Middle", "Late")),
    Stimulation = factor(Stimulation, levels = c("SHAM", "aMCC", "PCC")),  # SHAM as reference
    Congruence  = factor(Congruence,  levels = c("congruent", "incongruent")),
    Subject     = factor(Subject)
  )

# Smithson & Verkuilen transformation to avoid exact 0/1 for beta family
n <- nrow(accuracy_by_stage_model)
accuracy_by_stage_model <- accuracy_by_stage_model %>%
  mutate(Accuracy = (Accuracy * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n)

prior_model <- get_prior(
  Accuracy ~ TaskStage * Stimulation + TaskStage * Congruence + TaskStage * Congruence * Stimulation +
    (1 + TaskStage * Stimulation + TaskStage * Congruence + TaskStage * Congruence * Stimulation || Subject),
  data = accuracy_by_stage_model
)

priors_model <- c(
  prior(normal(3.14,  0.4),  class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "Congruenceincongruent"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "StimulationaMCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "StimulationaMCC:Congruenceincongruent"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "StimulationPCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "StimulationPCC:Congruenceincongruent"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageLate"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageLate:Congruenceincongruent"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageLate:StimulationaMCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageLate:StimulationaMCC:Congruenceincongruent"),  # was missing
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageLate:StimulationPCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageLate:StimulationPCC:Congruenceincongruent"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageMiddle"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageMiddle:Congruenceincongruent"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageMiddle:StimulationaMCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageMiddle:StimulationaMCC:Congruenceincongruent"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageMiddle:StimulationPCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "TaskStageMiddle:StimulationPCC:Congruenceincongruent")
)

# Fit brms model
brms_accuracy_model <- brm(
  Accuracy ~ TaskStage * Stimulation + TaskStage * Congruence + TaskStage * Congruence * Stimulation +
    (1 + TaskStage * Stimulation + TaskStage * Congruence + TaskStage * Congruence * Stimulation || Subject),
  data   = accuracy_by_stage_model,
  family = Beta(),
  prior  = priors_model,
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores  = 4,
  seed   = 123,
  refresh = 0
)

# Summary of the model
summary(brms_accuracy_model)

# Conditional effects plot
plot(conditional_effects(brms_accuracy_model), ask = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Combined visualization with paired lines showing individual subjects
accuracy_by_stage$Stimulation <- relevel(accuracy_by_stage$Stimulation, "aMCC")
p_acc_stage_paired <- ggpaired(
  accuracy_by_stage,
  x = "TaskStage",
  y = "Accuracy",
  id = "Subject",
  fill = "Stimulation",
  line.color = "grey",
  line.size = 0.2,
  facet.by = "Stimulation"
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC" = "#CC6677",
    "SHAM" = "#E69F00",
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC" = "#CC6677",
    "SHAM" = "#E69F00",
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Stimulation),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 2,
    color = "black",
    fill = "white",
    stroke = 0.8,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy Across Task Stages (Paired by Subject)",
    x = "Task Stage",
    y = "Accuracy",
    fill = "Stimulation"
  )

print(p_acc_stage_paired)
```
